# Data Inventory

**Last Updated**: 2026-05-25 (auto-generated)

Generated by `python -m yen_gov coverage`. Do not hand-edit. Re-run after every ingest. Indicator coverage is derived from [datasets/indicators/in/](../../datasets/indicators/in/); the declared election catalogue lives at [datasets/taxonomy/election_events.json](../../datasets/taxonomy/election_events.json); on-disk election artifacts live under [datasets/elections/](../../datasets/elections/). The Temporal Richness meter (● filled / ○ empty) is explained in [docs/architecture/backend/coverage.md](../architecture/backend/coverage.md).

## Summary

- 303 (state, event) slices on disk across 31 states / 139 cohorts.
- 44,286 per-AC result artifacts emitted in total.

## 1. Indicators

79 artifact(s) under `datasets/indicators/in/`. The Temporal Richness meter projects each indicator's `coverage.temporal` span onto 7 cells of 3 fiscal years (buckets: FY06–FY08, FY09–FY11, FY12–FY14, FY15–FY17, FY18–FY20, FY21–FY23, FY24–FY26). Snapshots fill exactly one cell and carry a `(snapshot)` tag.

**Frontend wiring**: 72 of 79 indicator artifacts are referenced by [`topic-catalogue.json`](../../datasets/taxonomy/topics.json) and therefore reachable from the IA today; **the remaining 7 are on disk but unreachable from any topic / state hub** (see §1Z below). The catalogue is hand-maintained — every new ingest must add (or consciously skip) a catalogue entry, or the data quietly drifts out of the citizen view. Implementation plan: [`TODO/VIZ-LAYER-GAPS-PLAN.md`](../../TODO/VIZ-LAYER-GAPS-PLAN.md); narrative + mis-framing debt: [data-coverage-report.md §6](data-coverage-report.md#6-frontend-wiring-gaps-visualization-layer).
